comments.author: SunMarc
comments.body: Thanks for the report, this is indeed a bit strange as you only increased the number of `num_processes`. Can you share the traceback after you do cltr+c (since it is stuck) ? cc @sayakpaul

comments.author: KihongK
comments.body:
@SunMarc 
I fixed this issue

I think there was a problem with parallel learning because there was a fabric manager issue. 
I reinstalled it and it works fine.

```
(dreambooth_env) test@df-5c-g001:~/diffusers/examples/dreambooth$ export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1
export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1
export TORCH_DISTRIBUTED_DEBUG=DETAIL
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export MODEL_NAME="Alpha-VLLM/Lumina-Image-2.0"
export INSTANCE_DIR="dog"
export OUTPUT_DIR="trained-lumina2-lora3"

accelerate launch --main_process_port=29501 --config_file  ~/.cache/huggingface/accelerate/default_config.yaml \

  --instance_data_dir=$INSTANCE_DIR \
  --output_dir=$OUTPUT_DIR \
  --mixed_precision="bf16" \
  --instance_prompt="a photo of sks dog" \
  --resolution=1024 \
  --train_batch_size=1 \

  --learning_rate=1e-4 \
  --report_to="wandb" \
  --lr_scheduler="constant" \
  --lr_warmup_steps=0 \
  --max_train_steps=500 \
  --validation_prompt="A photo of sks dog in a bucket" \
  --validation_epochs=25 \
  --seed="0" \
  --push_to_hub
```
